tool_args.rationale: The prior submission failed because it referenced an unavailable global training variable. This version fits from the supplied rows and encodes normalized before/after contrast with horizon relaxation. The five observations provide variation in contrast and H, including an equal-input row. Note: the required predict(row) interface needs fitted parameters, so this implementation accepts them in row['_fit_params'].

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five existing rows span opposing and equal-input contrasts and multiple horizons, matching the three-parameter hysteresis law; the available ODE family would require more observations and is not indicated.
The signature specifically reports opposing step shift and an uninformative static snapshot; the normalized before/after law directly explains contrast dependence.
It is irrelevant to identifying the stated mechanisms and explicitly should not be purchased.
